authority: W0 independently reviewed, integrated and re-verified the producer output. This record is separate from the producer handoff.

subject.title: Personal Office app shell and information architecture

integration.method: Each producer commit was path-audited before an exact ordered cherry-pick. No merge, quarantine commit or unreviewed path was used.

ownership.note: All source paths are renderer shell/store/style/App plus the IA document. The additional two paths are the producer handoff and worklog. No main/**, shared/personal-office/**, manifest, lockfile, lease, ledger, acceptance or quarantine path came from W2.
